stories_kpis.title: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium Successfully Launched
stories_kpis.summary: IVR organized its first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp in November 2024, bringing together 80 professionals from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping.
stories_kpis.narrative: In a strategic expansion of its knowledge-sharing mission, IVR successfully launched the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium on November 4, 2024, in Antwerp. The event attracted approximately 80 participants representing insurers, brokers, surveyors, shipping companies, maritime lawyers, and other stakeholder groups. The colloquium featured eight presentations organized across three sessions, addressing contemporary challenges including motor daily values, classification society roles, decarbonization impacts, and clean maritime solutions for the sector.

stories_kpis.title: Strong International Participation at Frankfurt Congress 2024
stories_kpis.summary: The annual IVR Congress held in Frankfurt from May 15-17, 2024, attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries, reinforcing IVR's position as a pan-European representative body for inland waterway interests.
stories_kpis.narrative: IVR's flagship annual congress in Frankfurt, where the association was founded in 1877, drew 225 participants representing the full breadth of European inland shipping stakeholders. The three-day event included board and committee meetings, a technical workshop on 'Navigating into the future, the value and versatility of inland waterways,' presentations on workplace market challenges, safety culture, hull sealability regulations, and sustainability initiatives. The General Assembly reviewed IVR's collaboration with international bodies including ZKR and the European Commission, updates on the vessel database, and the association's strengthened focus on emissions and climate change.

company_description: COFACE SA, through its subsidiaries, provides trade credit insurance products and services for small and medium enterprises, mid-market companies, international corporations, international companies, financial institutions, and clients of distribution partners. It offers insurance products, including TradeLiner; EasyLiner, a range of contracts for small and medium enterprises; GlobaLiner, that offers multinationals services, and management and oversight tools; CofaNet, a central internet portal that enables policyholders to manage their contracts; Coface Dashboard, a tool providing client risk analyses and reports; CofaMove, a mobile app that includes the key features of CofaNet; CofaServe, an API offer; and AlyX, a credit risk management software, as well as Single Risk medium-term insurance for commercial and political risks. The company also provides business information, debt collection, factoring and surety bonds services. In addition, it offers contract surety bonds, customs and excise bonds, environmental surety bonds, legal bonds for temporary employment companies, and payment guarantees. Further, the company provides Urba360, a universal risk business assessment; Full repo

description.long_fr: Coface est un acteur mondial de l'assurance-crédit. Le groupe protège les entreprises contre le risque de défaillance de leurs clients commerciaux à travers ~100 pays. Il propose aussi des services d'information d'entreprise, de recouvrement de créances et de caution. Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~1.84 Md €.
description.long_en: Coface is a global trade credit insurance player. The group protects companies against the risk of customer default across ~100 countries. It also provides business information, debt collection and surety services. 2024 revenue: ~€1.84 bn.
description.long_de: Coface ist ein weltweit tätiger Kreditversicherer. Der Konzern schützt Unternehmen vor dem Risiko des Zahlungsausfalls ihrer Geschäftskunden in rund 100 Ländern. Er bietet zudem Unternehmensinformationsdienste, Inkassodienstleistungen und Bürgschaften an. Konzernumsatz 2024: ~1,84 Mrd. €.
